name: e-invoicing-tr-tax-type-codes
title: UBL-TR tax type codes (e-Fatura)
description: The TaxTypeCode values written under TaxTotal on Turkish e-invoices (VAT, ÖTV, stamp duty and other taxes), with official Turkish names and abbreviations from the GİB code list, plus two codes that the UBL-TR schematron accepts but the guide does not name.

sources.title: UBL-TR Kod Listeleri, Versiyon 1.43, Temmuz 2026 (section 1.9 TaxTypeCode, Vergi Kodları Listesi), in UBLTR_1.2.1_Kilavuzlar.zip, Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı, retrieved 2026-11-16
e-Fatura Paketi, schematron/UBL-TR_Codelist.xml (TaxType; package history up to 2026-07-01), Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı, retrieved 2026-11-16: used for in_schematron and for codes 0059 and 9015

fields.name: code
fields.description: Four-digit tax code written to cac:TaxScheme/cbc:TaxTypeCode under cac:TaxTotal. Keep leading zeros (0003).

fields.name: name
fields.description: Turkish tax name as printed in the Vergi Kodları Listesi. Empty when the code is only in the schematron (0059, 9015).

fields.name: abbreviation
fields.description: Short label (KISALTMA) as printed in the guide. Empty when name is empty.

fields.name: in_guide
fields.description: true when the code appears in the Vergi Kodları Listesi of Kod Listeleri §1.9.

fields.name: in_schematron
fields.description: true when TaxType in the UBL-TR schematron accepts the code.
